description.value: Artisan Suites on Bowen is a smoke-free, pet-free, self-check-in boutique hotel offering four individually designed suites on Bowen Island, located in the commercial hub of Artisan Square roughly 800 m from the ferry dock. The property is accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver, making it a natural stopover for cyclists touring the island. Guests staying more than one night are asked to leave upper parking spaces free for day shoppers, suggesting some awareness of visitor turnover.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 14m; stands (2 spaces) at 85m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, self-check-in boutique hotel with 4 suites on Bowen Island, accessible via ferry from Horseshoe Bay. All suites list Wi-Fi as an amenity. The /todo page lists multiple nearby restaurants (Barcelona Tapas & Wine Bar, The Bowen Pub, Doc Mogan's, etc.) confirming nearby evening food. No mention of bike storage, laundry, tools, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site; the self-check-in model also means no traditional front desk staff to advise on bike handling.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the property is on Bowen Island — a distinct municipality. May cause incorrect geographic indexing.
Website lists address only as 'Artisan Square, Bowen Island' with no street number or street name, so OSM address '539 Artisan Lane' cannot be confirmed from the website.
Phone number (+1-604-797-1107) does not appear on the website; only an email (info@artisansuites.com) is listed — phone cannot be confirmed or denied.
Self-check-in model with no traditional front desk means bike procedure and secure storage are unverifiable without direct contact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable boutique hotel on Bowen Island with a live website and booking system; clearly useful to touring cyclists visiting the island.
enrichment_extras.notes: Artisan Eats Cafe is located on the floor directly below the suites, per the website, making it a convenient breakfast option — though the hotel does not appear to offer breakfast itself.

Nearby evening food.detail: Multiple dinner venues listed on /todo page within Artisan Square and the cove: Barcelona Tapas & Wine Bar, The Bowen Pub (open 7 days/week lunch and dinner), Doc Mogan's (seafood, pasta, steaks & salads), and others

wow_evidence: self-check-in boutique hotel offering four individually designed suites on Bowen Island

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Four-suite boutique hotel at Artisan Square, ~$200-280
